title: OWNERS -- who must review a change to which paths, declared once
description: A host's review owners as rows: a path pattern (the gitignore-style pattern every owners-file grammar reads) and the owners whose review a change matching it requires. Declared in the kit's own terms and turned into a product's owners file by that product's adapter (ADR-024): the kit enforces nothing here -- a hosting service does, and only where its own protection is switched on, which is a person's act outside the tree. Order matters where a product reads the LAST matching row, so rows are served in the order declared.

pattern.description: A path pattern: no whitespace and no `#`, which would end it or turn it into a comment.

owners.description: Each owner as a hosting service names one: `@user`, `@org/team`, or an email address.
